Name: George Recovery
Author: usaji666
Description:
This mod adds a brand-new Chinese healing storyline for George.
The cutscene triggers on rainy days between 9:00 and 18:00 in any season, once the player reaches an 8-heart friendship level with both Harvey and George. Players will assist Harvey in gathering medical ingredient, which must be stored inside the quest refrigerator located on the upper floor of Harvey’s clinic.
After completing the treatment segment, return to George’s house to activate the second cutscene. From then on, George will stand and move freely between 12:00 and 17:00 on regular non-festival days; he will remain in his wheelchair during festivals, other story events, and all other hours.

Version 0.4.2 adds automatic language support for English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Spanish. It also introduces a new bedtime routine for George and Evelyn, George’s final custom standing and walking sprites, improved  more positive daily dialogue for both characters.
[heading]Prerequisites[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[/list][heading]Language[/heading]
Chinese、English、Japanese、Spanish. Any other languages will fallback to English automatically.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Tested fully on macOS
